title: Development and evaluation of 0.05 degree terrestrial water storage estimates using Community Atmosphere Biosphere Land Exchange (CABLE) land surface model and assimilation of GRACE data

anchor_use_verified.paper_actually_used: Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data (CHIRPS)
anchor_use_verified.evidence: Section 2.2 states that the CABLE model is forced with precipitation and that, for precipitation, the study uses CHIRPS on a 0.05 degree grid. It then spatially averages CHIRPS for 0.5 degree simulations and temporally disaggregates daily CHIRPS to 3-hour time steps.
anchor_use_verified.current_catalog_equivalent: UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY is the GEE CHIRPS v2.0 Final daily precipitation collection with the precipitation band in mm/day.
companion_datasets: CABLE-SSGW land surface and groundwater model
GSFC GRACE Mascon monthly TWS variations
GLASS LAI and land-cover/soil parameter sources
ESA CCI, GLEAM, SASMAS, groundwater and FLUXNET validation data

seed_replacement.replacement_reason: The user requested CHIRPS to replace single_dataset/task_002. This 2021 HESS seed is earlier than the evaluation year, contains explicit operational CHIRPS precipitation use, and opens the strict window 2021 < paper_year <= 2026.

idea.research_question: 在澳大利亚，0.05° CHIRPS 降水强迫与高分辨率 CABLE-SSGW 和 GRACE 同化结合后，能否更准确地重建陆地水储量及其土壤水、地下水和蒸散发相关变化？
idea.hypothesis: 站点校正的高分辨率 CHIRPS 降水能够改善陆面模型水量输入；当其与 CABLE-SSGW 状态方程和 GRACE 月尺度总水储量约束结合时，模型可同时保留细空间结构并降低水储量状态误差。
idea.mechanism: 降水强迫控制土壤水、冠层水、雪水和地下水补给过程；CABLE-SSGW 将这些水文过程转化为多分量水储量状态，GRACE Mascon 提供月尺度总水储量观测用于同化校正，独立土壤水分、蒸散发、地下水和通量塔数据用于验证。

key_variables.target: 0.05° 陆地水储量及其组成部分

idea.analytical_approach: 以 CHIRPS 日降水和 Princeton 气象强迫驱动 CABLE-SSGW，在 0.5° 与 0.05° 网格上模拟多分量水储量；对 CHIRPS 做空间聚合或时间分解以匹配模型步长；用集合卡尔曼平滑将 GSFC GRACE Mascon 月尺度 TWS 变化同化进模型状态，并用卫星和地面观测评估土壤水分、蒸散发和地下水结果。
idea.expected_contribution: 展示高分辨率站点融合降水、陆面模型和 GRACE 观测同化如何联合提升大陆尺度水储量重建，为干旱、水资源和地下水监测提供可复用的数据组合。
idea.falsification_condition: 如果 CHIRPS 强迫与高分辨率 CABLE 配置无法相对于低分辨率模拟改善独立土壤水、蒸散发或地下水验证，或 GRACE 同化后的水储量改进主要来自平滑而非降水驱动过程，则该假设不成立。
